title: Battle of Saint-Louis-du-Sud
summary:
The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Saint-Louis-du-Sud", at revision 1370588032, opens: "The Battle of Saint-Louis-du-Sud was fought on 22 March 1748 in the French colony of Saint-Domingue during the War of the Austrian Succession. A British Royal Navy squadron under the command of Admiral Charles Knowles attacked and destroyed a large French fort in Saint-Louis-du-Sud ,
then under the command of the interim Governor of Saint-Domingue, Étienne Cochard de Chastenoye." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q14644681, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1748 naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
